name: 场景几何一致性分析
algorithm: Scene Geometry Consistency — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes scene geometry consistency for deepfake detection:

1. **3DScene重建**: From video frames, approximate 3D scene geometry is estimated using structure-from-motion, depth estimation, and perspective cues. The spatial layout — room dimensions, furniture positions, wall angles — is reconstructed.

2. **几何一致性验证**: The estimated scene geometry should remain consistent across all frames. The method tracks 3D reconstruction consistency — deformations, scale changes, or geometric shifts indicate manipulation where inserted content doesn't match the scene's 3D structure.

3. **Person-ScenePerspectiveMatch**: The person (particularly face scale and perspective distortion) should be consistent with their position in the 3D scene. Face size should scale correctly with estimated distance from camera. Deepfake composites may show faces at incorrect apparent distances — face scale inconsistent with scene geometry.

4. **阴影-GeometryAgreement**: Shadows in the scene should be consistent with the 3D geometry and estimated illumination. Ground shadows, cast shadows, and attached shadows should all agree with a single light model and the scene geometry. Manipulated scenes may show shadow-geometry conflicts.

5. **相机运动-SceneGeometry相干性**: As the camera moves, the relative motion of objects at different depths (motion parallax) should be consistent with the scene geometry. The method analyzes motion parallax patterns — composited elements at wrong estimated depths produce incorrect parallax, revealing manipulation.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through scene geometry consistency analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频

references.title: Verdoliva, L. (2020). Media Forensics and DeepFakes: An Overview. IEEE JSTSP.
